decision.credit128_scope: New session and future-session policy verified LEGACY64; old B3 ended through owner manual reconnect. No reinterpretation, downgrade, server rollback or fleet rollout.
decision.required_action: None. Return confirmed and experiment closed; no further load, build, deployment or tuning requested.
rationale: Single gains +24.93%, +89.32%, +3.65%; first two comparisons have unequal background/ACK/retry conditions. Do not claim the full gain is caused by window.
Final pair removes most credit stalls but yields only1.68s less single phone-wall time, with aggregate−13.61% and control full latency+23.28%. Balanced owner improvement is not established.
Shared RS remains occupied/head-blocked and retries remain; lowering credit stalls alone is not overall speed acceptance.
No fourth/fifth pair, universal-network proof requirement, new window value or further transport tuning is introduced.

limitations: Snapshot brackets use existing journal/host wall-time alignment; cross-clock offset was not independently measured. Server node_ns denominator is process-local monotonic.
Snapshot brackets contain background and boundary time; normalized fractions are not exact request-local time shares.
Parallel HTTP request-to-Mux-ID one-to-one mapping is not established by equal sizes; retain both HTTP rows and the unordered attributed Mux-ID set.
Background DATA is the difference of total owner-Mux HandedDATA and identified measurement stream deltas over the same bracket, not every layer of background traffic.
Gateway process/credentials changed externally before A3; A3/B3 use the same new process. Different media sessions and radio/ACK conditions remain.
Historical protocol_errors before-load values are retained; exact establishment snapshots may be missing. No session counter reset or cross-session subtraction.
No one-to-one parallel HTTP/Mux-ID assignment from equal body sizes. Both HTTP and stream rows are retained.
Six phases only; no extra measurements or statistical population confidence claim.
Control requests measure application latency, not RTT. Sampled gateway RSS includes all sessions and does not establish a global memory cap.
Exact-at-establishment protocol_error snapshots are unavailable; first-observed cumulative errors and pre/post load increments are retained, including pre-A3 interruption and old unknown scope.
Synthetic/local byte-exact tests are not physical origin-byte-exact acceptance; successful measured bodies are full length with locally observed hashes.
Return-only session protocol_errors first/last1/1, exact establishment sample unavailable; no application request was run and no origin/cause is inferred. This is not B3 counter growth.
